responsibility: Implements the executable logic of the LM32 target backend behind GCC target hooks. This file owns LM32 ABI and code-generation behavior that cannot be expressed purely in .md patterns: frame layout computation and prologue/epilogue emission, argument passing and varargs setup, return-value-in-memory rules, PIC and small-data address handling, branch and compare expansion, block moves, operand printing, register elimination and address legitimacy checks, and RTX cost modeling. It consumes GCC RTL/tree data and target flags and produces target-specific RTL sequences and hook answers used throughout reload, expand, and final emission.
same_name_distinction: Defines the imperative C++ side of the LM32 backend: target hook implementations and helper routines for ABI decisions, frame handling, address legitimacy, operand printing, and RTL cost/expansion logic that are invoked by or complement the declarative descriptions in lm32.md and the compile-time macros/options from lm32.h and lm32.opt.
